name: Microsoft Azure AD / Entra ID
description: Microsoft Azure Active Directory (Entra ID) SAML configuration

entity_id.label: Azure AD Identifier (Entity ID)
entity_id.help: Found in Azure Portal > Enterprise Applications > Your App > Single sign-on > Azure AD Identifier

sso_url.label: Login URL
sso_url.help: Found in Azure Portal > Enterprise Applications > Your App > Single sign-on > Login URL

slo_url.label: Logout URL
slo_url.help: Same as Login URL for Azure AD

certificate.label: Certificate (Base64)
certificate.help: Download from Azure Portal > Enterprise Applications > Your App > Single sign-on > SAML Signing Certificate > Certificate (Base64)

setup_instructions: 1. Go to Azure Portal > Azure Active Directory > Enterprise Applications
2. Click '+ New application' > 'Create your own application'
3. Name it 'FreePBX' and select 'Integrate any other application you don't find in the gallery'
- Identifier (Entity ID): Download from FreePBX SAML metadata URL
6. In 'Attributes & Claims', ensure these claims are mapped:
7. Download the Certificate (Base64) and copy the Login URL
8. Enter these values in FreePBX SAML configuration
